requirements.rationale: Non-normative markdown structure: the design document title line carries no requirement content.
Document metadata (date line), not a requirement.
Document metadata (approval status); recorded as design authority context in the spec Input field, not as a requirement.
The v1 standalone-script scope is adopted as the standalone-operation requirement plus the In Scope section.
Included unit had empty spec_ids and reached no acceptance criterion; the no-workflow-integration boundary it states is enforced by FR-045 and verified by the import-scan test reaching AC-022.

Non-normative markdown heading (Purpose).
The purpose statement (challenge a specification, unanswerable questions become findings) is realized by the two-call mechanism and the finding partition.
Line-fragment continuation of IN-REQ-60DEBB978E62.
The grounding rule is operationalized: round 2 answers from spec text alone and evidence is quoted from the actual file lines.
Line-fragment continuation of IN-REQ-BF81CFD48938.
Non-normative markdown heading (Interface).
Non-normative code-fence delimiter line.
The full command usage line maps to the four interface requirements: positional path plus the questions, claude-cmd, and timeout options.
Non-normative code-fence delimiter line.
The questions option with default 15 is adopted as the question-count option plus the round-1 cap instruction.
The claude-cmd option, its default, and its test-seam role are adopted; the binary-versus-command ambiguity (U-004) is resolved as shell-quoting word split.
The per-call timeout with default 300 seconds is adopted, applied independently per subprocess invocation.
Exit codes 0 (report written) and 1 (bad input) are adopted; exit 1 is extended by an explicit pre-flight writability check resolving U-005.
Exit codes 2 (CLI unavailable) and 3 (unrecoverable parse failure) are adopted with a deliberate boundary: exit 2 only for executable-not-found (U-007).
The two-fresh-calls mechanism is adopted as exactly 2 logical model calls, each an isolated subprocess.
Round-1 input (spec text plus generation instruction) is adopted as the round-1 prompt content requirement.
The at-most-N cap and the five weakness categories are adopted verbatim in the round-1 instruction requirement.
Line-fragment continuation of IN-REQ-1C338DB49929.
Question tagging with target requirement ID and source line references is adopted in the round-1 schema; line references are made verifiable via 1-based numbering (U-006).
Strict JSON output is adopted with the internal tension (WHY1 ISS-002) resolved explicitly: tolerant extraction of exactly 1 JSON object, then strict validation.
Round 2 as a fresh call receiving only spec text plus questions is adopted.
The questions-not-reasoning restriction is adopted: round-2 prompt carries identifiers and question texts only.
Answering from spec text alone with one verdict per question is adopted.
The ANSWERED verdict with quoted answering lines is adopted; ANSWERED questions route to the audit appendix.
The UNANSWERABLE verdict with the named gap is adopted in the verdict set and the evidence-rendering rule.
The CONTRADICTED verdict with both sides quoted is adopted; contradictions rank first.
Deterministic assembly with no third model call is adopted as the zero-further-calls plus partition requirements.
Contradictions-first ranking and retention of ANSWERED questions are adopted.
The collapsed audit-section rendering — the requirement dropped during DISCOVER (gap 1, TRACKER RF-1) — is restored explicitly.
Non-normative markdown heading (Isolation contract).
Subprocess execution from a neutral temporary working directory is adopted as a testable outcome.

The cwd-isolation requirement is adopted, but its premise is challenged per WHY1 ISS-001: repo-scope isolation is guaranteed while operator-scope residual exposure is a documented limitation pending the OQ-002 spike.
Line-fragment continuation of IN-REQ-DDDD35B79FFA.
The round-2 no-rationale rule is adopted as a prohibition requirement with a stub-verified acceptance scenario.
Non-normative markdown heading (Round JSON schemas).
The round-1 schema fields (id, question, target, lines, category) are adopted in the round-1 validation requirement.
Line-fragment continuation of IN-REQ-1BB9602CB2BA.
The round-2 schema fields (id, verdict, answer, evidence_lines) are adopted in the round-2 validation requirement.
The identifier bijection rule (every round-1 id exactly once) is adopted as an explicit requirement, per SCOUT's recommendation to elevate it from schema prose.
Missing or extra identifiers as parse failures routed to the retry path are adopted.
Non-normative markdown heading (Output).
Report location beside the challenged spec plus the stdout summary are adopted.
Finding counts with top 3 in the summary, plus overwrite-with-no-history semantics, are adopted; write mechanics deliberately stay unspecified (U-010).
The regenerable-file property is adopted in the report-write requirement and the Out of Scope history exclusion.
Report header contents (spec path, run date, question and finding counts) are adopted.
Findings-section contents (verdict, question, target REQ, evidence) are adopted.
The audit appendix of answered-and-discarded questions with answering lines is adopted.
Non-normative markdown heading (Error handling).
Exit 2 with an install pointer, mirroring the ERR-CLI-MISSING pattern verified in spec 029, is adopted.
Line-fragment continuation of IN-REQ-49464B14EFA0.
One corrective retry per round is adopted; the retry content ambiguity (U-003) is resolved: failure named, prior output not echoed, timeout retried as plain re-issue.
Second failure exiting 3 with raw output saved to the .sue-debug dump is adopted.
Exit 1 before any model call on a bad spec path is adopted as a pre-flight requirement.
Timeouts routed to the parse-failure path (retry once, then exit 3) are adopted, with fresh timeout budgets per invocation (A-007).
Non-normative markdown heading (Testing).
Pytest unit tests for the deterministic parts at the designated test path are adopted as a deliverable requirement.
The enumerated tested surfaces (prompt assembly, extraction and validation, filtering and ranking, rendering, exit codes) are adopted as the 7 deterministic behavior groups.
Faking model calls via a stub executable through the claude-cmd seam is adopted.
Line-fragment continuation of IN-REQ-B9724D0168AB.

The manual live acceptance run against spec 029 is adopted with an explicit tolerance added per WHY1 ISS-003; maps to T-S01 through FR-034, the requirement AC-023 cites for the live acceptance report.

The overlap success criterion is adopted as overlap with at least 1 of the 3 named issues within at most 3 attempts — a traceable tolerance amendment fixing the flaky-by-construction criterion (contradiction 3); maps to T-S01 through FR-034, the requirement AC-023 cites for the live acceptance report.

The 3 named known issues remain the acceptance anchors; A-004 requires re-verification or a frozen fixture before the run; maps to T-S01 through FR-034, the requirement AC-023 cites for the live acceptance report.
Non-normative markdown heading (Non-goals).
Included unit had empty spec_ids; its non-goals are operationally enforced by FR-042 (no answer encoding back into the spec, AC-010) and FR-045 (no workflow integration, AC-022).
Exclusion of an orchestration CLI verb and answer re-encoding is adopted in Out of Scope plus the standalone-operation requirement.
Included unit had empty spec_ids; the interface-stability promise is realized by the frozen v1 surface FR-001 and FR-003, exercised end-to-end by AC-001.
